title: The Whole Songbook
author: Sebastian Hartwell
blurb: Ada Okafor, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
